## Batch 29 authoring

Authored 9 A-page items and 4 B-page examples, including five local mathematical suppliers needed for the complete arguments. The manifest, source coverage, proof contracts, cross-batch ledger, and notes are in place. The notes record the conflict between the design reservation and `plan-spec.json`.

The stability proof and worked values now account for \(V_\ell=W_\ell/2\), so \(W_\ell''=2V_\ell''\). The Coulomb theorem and example also state the required \(\mathrm{AC}_\omega\) assumption. The added calculus suppliers have full-text references in [OpenStax Calculus §2.3](https://openstax.org/books/calculus-volume-1/pages/2-3-the-limit-laws), [NIST DLMF §4.23](https://dlmf.nist.gov/4.23), and [OpenStax Precalculus §6.3](https://openstax.org/books/precalculus-2e/pages/6-3-inverse-trigonometric-functions).

## Checks

Precheck passed for all 12 proof-bearing items. Content policy passed for all 13 items; proof contracts passed for 13/13; rendercheck passed for all 15 item and page files. Coverage has 39 results with no errors or warnings, and source-fetch check resolved all 11 sources, including four documented drops.

The assigned dependency levels recompute correctly. The full-run level check and both `step1-decisions.mjs record` attempts stop with `Duplicate item undefined`: batch 42’s `qft-mf03` and `qft-mf03-examples` manifests contain seven string entries without item IDs. No readiness records were written. The 11 items with current prerequisites are documented as intended `ready`; the Coulomb physical theorem and its B example are documented as `escalated` pending batch 24. The required proof-layout check also fails before layout because the sibling web renderer cannot resolve `@/components` from `ItemBody.tsx`.
